market_story: CC_CHP / CT_CHP: a topping-cycle cogen's power train follows its host's steam demand, not the LMP — the host's process-steam load is around the clock, so the real CAISO merchant steam hosts (Midway-Sunset, Elk Hills, THUMS) run FLAT: measured CEMS net 0.65-0.76 GW across every hour-of-day (May-2023, hod max/min 1.16). The model's marginal-cost dispatch idles a cogen whenever its offer sits above the margin, so without the floor the class ducked to 0.06 GW in the solar belly — dispatch physics the steam contract does not permit. The floor forces only the measured multi-year operating level (all-hours p25 of available-CF), grid-share scaled, availability-clipped (real outages still relax it), with dispatchable surplus riding above on price; cycling cogens measure p25=0 and carry no floor. Downstream: the forced steam base displaces economic CC_REGULAR trough dispatch (C1-2024 +6.01 -> +5.37 TWh) and shaves the soft-month trough over-price (May/Jun-2023 -1.6/-1.9), because the market's real trough supply stack contains this always-on gas the model previously re-priced at the margin.
